business.what: A private physiotherapy practice in rented rooms, about 22 consultations a week at $115.

business.gst: Allied health services are often GST-free. A physiotherapy consultation that is necessary treatment carries no GST, but GST-free sales still count towards the $75,000 registration threshold, so the practice registers and lodges anyway. About 94% of sales are GST-free. Braces and bands sold at the desk, and ergonomic assessments for employers, are taxable.
business.bas: Quarterly, most of the income at the GST-free label.
